items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And I remember it was me, Jay Leonhart, John Bunch, I forget who else. Small band.

ctx.x: Oh man it was like, there was a thing I remember there was a scene where Louis is standing there and one of the agency people is asking Louis to play a turnaround coming out of something. And Louis is just kind of like smiling, not really saying much. And the conductor is trying to talk about it and Louis is — and finally one of the guys, nobody knew what was happening and one of the guys in the band, the trombone player yells out, he says, “Hey man that’s Louis.
